3490-5231-6824-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6824-8333.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2105-3603-4359-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-4359-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-4359-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

3277-4113-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by tapping Izzet Chronarch due to Essence Flux's convoke ability, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7096-8095--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
7096-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

62-833-3827-5233.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3827-5233.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Boros Garrison, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2604-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ugin, the Ineffable.
Repeat

1263-4871-5075-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-2033-6321-7060.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-6321-7060.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4036-4285-7497.description:
Cast Wisdom of Ages by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, copying Wisdom of Ages.
Resolve the copy of Wisdom of Ages, returning all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-4758-7082-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2440-4758-7082-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

233-2645-6871-7175.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {B} as it's a Swamp land due to Toph and Urborg
Lavaleaper triggers, adding {B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-4779-7189.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-3129-3899-4068.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

914-3335-6968.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-6968.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-6968.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

304-1805-1978.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Tough Cookie.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2921-3108.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.
628-2921-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-4785.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-4785.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1456-1987-4423-5116.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3305-4681-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2906-4050-4484-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-4050-4484-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4050-4484-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-4050-4484-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2364-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

2187-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2187-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake, targeting Possessed Skaab
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

2608-4499-4851.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

372-1090-2885.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-2885.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Abdel Adrian and exiling Rescue the Foal.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

851-856-1201-1651.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Food tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

876-1061-2362.notablePrerequisites:
Endless Evil attached to Timestream Navigator.
You control nine permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
876-1061-2362.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Endless Evil triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
If you do not have the city's blessing, both Timestream Navigator's ascend abilities trigger, giving you the city's blessing.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2644-4763.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using {C}{C}.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand.
2034-2644-4763.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to the creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Koll triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3373-5136.notablePrerequisites: Quietus Spike attached to any creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3373-5136.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Quietus Spike attached.
Quietus Spike triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1420-2178-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-5231.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.

1684-2178-2557-4050.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-2557-4050.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

282-1267.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
282-1267.description:
Attack with Delina.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Medomai that is tapped and attacking.
The Medomai token(s) deal combat damage, triggering their abilities, allowing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1486-1604-3297.notablePrerequisites: Ith does not have summoning sickness.
1486-1604-3297.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution targeting Magda, changing all instances of "Dwarf" to either "Human" or "Wizard".
Attack with Ith.
While Ith is still attacking, activate Ith by tapping itself, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Ith's ability, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 3.

2655-5005.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
2655-5005.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Ral triggers for each copy, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
Repeat from step 7.
